name: Warp Factories
desc: Open infrastructure for running software factories of coding agents.
desc_zh: 用于运行编程智能体工厂的开放基础设施。
solves: Adopting agents one repo at a time never compounds; Factories gives the whole organisation one place to define and run them.
solves_zh: 一个仓库一个仓库地引入智能体永远无法积累；Factories 给整个组织一个统一的地方定义和运行它们。
best_for: Your company wants agents across every repository, not a pilot in one team.
best_for_zh: 公司想让智能体进入所有仓库，而不是只在一个团队试点。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — docs.warp.dev/changelog/2026; B — Hacker News story 2026-08-18）。 Changelog entry 2026.08.27 (v0.2026.08.26.17.59) under New features, pointing at the launch blog post.
